set.body:
From review of fx-render-capture (b81eb83). CanvasPlotHost holds up to three full-size canvases (scene, under/selection, overlay) plus clip/temp buffers; at an accepted 8192x8192 device surface three canvases need ~805 MB, above Prism's 512 MiB texture pool, so createRTTexture returns null and NGCanvas NPEs (now caught by the RenderFailures harness, but still a runtime failure).

Acceptance: either (a) PlotSurface/CanvasPlotHost refuses surfaces whose total canvas bytes exceed a stated budget with the existing typed InvalidSurface-style error naming the budget, or (b) the under and overlay canvases are allocated lazily (only when a selection/painter exists) and sized to need, with a documented maximum; a test at the boundary on the software pipeline.
set.title: CanvasPlotHost: bound total canvas texture bytes (8192 px surfaces exceed the Prism pool)
